reaction.episode: DIGESTION episode, data through October 27 and not stale: SPX 7,722.6 is 1.55% below its 120-day high of 7,844.52, 0.33% above its 50-day at 7,697.01 and 5.81% above its 200-day at 7,298.87; SMH at $557.98 sits in Zone 1 (540-565) while NVDA at $217.94 sits above its Zone 1 band (200-210); VIX is 17.52 and HY OAS is 3.23, both calm, and the mechanical capitulation tally is 2 of 4 (zone occupancy and credit calm confirmed; no volume climax reversal, no VIX rollover).
reaction.invalidation: A held SPX close above 7,820 with SMH above $600 voids the Watch stance and the trap framing; conversely, HY OAS above 4% or VIX above 25 voids the calm-digestion framing and replaces it with a regime-break stance.

ladder.response: Stage Tranche A: a single 25% probe into the DATA_AHEAD dislocation names (AVGO first), sized as a probe, not a position, and only on that combined print
ladder.trigger: SMH prints into Zone 2 ($470-505) with the mechanical tally reaching 3 of 4 or better

ladder.response: Treat as the trap case: do not chase the bounce, add nothing, and wait for the retest verdict; a rejection back below 7,750 confirms the trap and keeps the stance at Watch
ladder.trigger: SPX bounces into the 7,750-7,820 failure zone (SMH 580-600) but fails to hold a close above 7,820 / $600

ladder.response: Stand down: no probes, no adds, ladder void for entries until credit and volatility calm again
ladder.trigger: HY OAS above 4% or VIX above 25

ladder.response: Upgrade stance to Probe: first staged entries into the DATA_AHEAD names (AVGO, then ONTO/VRT on their own confirmation), with stops at the Zone 1 floors
ladder.trigger: Held SPX close above 7,820 with SMH held above $600 and VIX rolling over from its 5-day high of 19.45

reaction.trapRisk: The pivot-and-fail scenario is the live risk today: SPX sits just below the 7,750-7,820 failure zone into the FOMC print, so the first bounce into that zone is the most likely bull trap. Entries must not chase it — require a held close above 7,820 (SMH above $600) before any probe becomes an add, and treat any intraday poke into the zone that closes back below 7,750 as confirmation to stay out.

strategyPosture: Watch. The tape is digesting under a failure zone into today's FOMC decision, with real DATA_AHEAD dislocation in semis and power but no capitulation confirmation (tally 2 of 4), so no new size is justified today; the dislocation names stay on the probe list, not the add list.

themes.counterRead: The rotation read holds only while credit stays loose: the divergence is real and worth tracking, because a flip in lending standards or a HY OAS break would convert a rotation story into a rollover story. Until then, index calm is not evidence that the leaders are healthy.
themes.dataAnchor: Mag7 names sit an average of 12.5% below their 52-week highs against SPY only 1.5% below its high, an 11-point divergence gap; GOOGL is the weakest Mag7 name at 21.5% below its high while AAPL is only 1.3% below. SPX itself is just 1.55% below its 120-day high at 7,722.6, and bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 0%, far below the ~40% stress threshold), with HY OAS at 3.23 and credit calm.
themes.label: Index-leadership rotation, not a broad rollover
themes.narrative: The tape reads as an index-level calm with weakness concentrated in the handful of names that dominate the index by weight: the broad market holds while former leaders lag.
themes.watchFor: Mag7 average distance from 52-week highs narrowing back toward SPY's 1.5%, or SLOOS/lending conditions tightening from the current 0% loose reading.

themes.counterRead: Fundamentals ahead of price is an opportunity only if the dislocation stops widening: none of these names has a capitulation print behind it, the mechanical tally is only 2 of 4, and SMH sits in Zone 1 rather than at a washed-out Zone 2. That argues for staged probes on confirmation, not a full add into a still-falling 20-day tape.
themes.dataAnchor: AVGO, the top conviction name at score 81 (tier A), is 30.8% below its high at $342.33 while revenue grows 55% year over year with a 67.8% gross margin and a 42.1% free-cash-flow margin. ONTO is 44.6% below its high with revenue up 22.1%, LRCX is 45.1% below its high with revenue up 131.3% per the input, and VRT is 45.1% below its high with revenue up 27.7%. MU is 26.0% below its high at $928.76, and AVGO's watchlist promotion score is 79.
themes.label: AI semiconductor dislocation: fundamentals ahead of price
themes.narrative: The market has priced the AI hardware complex as if its growth broke: SMH is down 8.06% over 20 days and 16.95% below its 120-day high, with AVGO, ONTO, LRCX and VRT all 31-45% below their 52-week highs.
themes.watchFor: SMH holding above its Zone 1 floor of $540, or a print into Zone 2 ($470-505) with the capitulation tally rising, before sizing beyond a probe.

themes.counterRead: A single-day 5-9% bounce after a 26-28% monthly fall is relief, not a bottom, and the VST split (insider buying versus a deteriorating revenue inflection) means the power basket cannot be bought as a unit. VST's insider signal is the one name-specific reason to keep it on the probe list; the rest of the bounce needs a second, held day before it means anything.
themes.dataAnchor: The one-day bounce has not erased the monthly damage: SMR is down 27.56% over one month, OKLO down 25.76%, and VST down 26.9% from its high at $146.66. VST carries a conviction score of 78 and insiders bought $1.17M at the trough, but its revenue inflection in the watchlist data is DETERIORATING, and BWXT is still 44.6% below its high at $134.07.
themes.label: Nuclear / AI power: bounce inside a drawdown, name quality split
themes.narrative: Today's tape says the power trade is back: SMR is up 8.73%, OKLO up 6.21% and VST up 5.13% on the day, after a month in which the same names fell hard.
themes.watchFor: VST holding its bounce and its revenue inflection turning from DETERIORATING, or SMR/OKLO giving back today's gains in full on the next session.

themes.counterRead: Calm here is genuinely calm, not complacent: VIX below its 5-day high of 19.45 and credit contained mean there is no stress signal forcing a defensive stance, but there is also no confirmation signal justifying an add. The FOMC print today is the event that converts this digestion into either a reclaim or a rejection, and positioning ahead of it is a guess, not a read.
themes.dataAnchor: SPX closed October 27 at 7,722.6, still below the 7,750-7,820 failure zone, while SMH at $557.98 sits inside Zone 1 (540-565) and the 10-year sits at 4.99% with the 2s10s curve at +0.22. VIX is 17.52, down 4.73% on the day, HY OAS is 3.23 with credit calm, and the mechanical tally is 2 of 4: zone occupancy and credit calm confirmed, no volume climax reversal and no VIX rollover.
themes.label: FOMC-eve digestion: calm tape under a failure zone
themes.narrative: With the FOMC decision due today (October 28, 11 news hits) and Microsoft and Alphabet results on deck, the market is digesting rather than trending: SPY is up 0.81% on the day and QQQ up 1.70%, but neither has reclaimed its failure zone.
themes.watchFor: A held SPX close above 7,820, or a rejection back below the 50-day at 7,697.01, on today's FOMC outcome.

whereWaveBuilds: The next move most likely materializes out of today's FOMC decision and the Microsoft/Alphabet prints on deck: a held reclaim of the SPX 7,750-7,820 failure zone (SMH above $600) turns digestion into a probe window, while a rejection from that zone sends the tape back toward the SMH Zone 1 floor at $540 and then Zone 2.
